start.text: Office? ITPL side? Meter illa, saar. One-fifty. Morning traffic, one-way, return empty.

deal.text: Sit, sit. Hold the bar. Nine-thirty we will reach — maybe nine-thirty-five.

walk.text: Your wish. Other autos will say two hundred, then you come back.

paid.text: Already paid, saar. Get in before the signal changes.
